_about: The single source of truth for how an episode is made. studio.py next prints the card for the episode's stage; skills hold the technique, this file holds the order and the creator's rules. Change a rule HERE (one line), not in five skills.
always: Write instructions, questions and reports in English. Only the script, VO text and on-screen Bangla are Bangla.

Topic test (channel data): the viewer's own money or a thing they hold beats policy topics; frame abstract topics through a personal example from the first line. Current series rules for the Claude project: claude/series-rules.md (the brief is an archive).
Reports are brief: use the gate templates below. Never list checks that passed, never repeat what the creator already approved.
Do not start a stage the creator did not ask for, and do not redo a step that state.py shows done.
ONE voiceover per request (one take of vo_paste.txt). Never offer A/B takes.
No scene numbers, chapter labels or chips on screen. Scene names are internal.
Key graphics inside the centre safe zone (y 285-1635, clear of the Shorts/Reels UI) but never leave the top and bottom bands empty: bleed fills them.

Caption lane: keep y ~1430-1550 free of key text and numbers in every scene (burned-in captions go there). Scene 1 can start from scenes/opener-loud.html; share splits from scenes/share-bar.html; the answer chain from scenes/chain-cards.html.
Series typeface Tiro Bangla (preset vox-money) on every video. Never switch fonts per episode.

Look: Vox / Johnny Harris style. Use ONLY the colours of the palette assigned by studio.py look (docs/look.md). No palette picked by hand, no dull, dated or dark-dominant colours (v0.8.1 palettes are energetic). Top/bottom bands and style elements differ from earlier episodes.

Sound: music preset and automatic sound effects are assigned by studio.py and played by audio.py. Never replace the music by hand, never silence the effects, never add loud ones. data-mood on every scene (first = intro, last = end).

Ending holds ~1 s after the last VO line (end_hold 1.0) so the Short loops; the closing chord lands on the last line, the last line is never faded under. (v0.8, channel data 7 Nov 2026: viewers swiped away during the old 3 s hold.)

Hook: the first 1.5 s decide whether YouTube keeps showing the Short (stayed-to-watch target >= 70 %). Scene 1 VO opens with the viewer's own stake or one short question; scene 1 visuals are loud: big question text + a large full-bleed photo, never a small framed photo with small text and empty space. Script target 85-100 Bangla words (~40-45 s).
In-video text must be readable: >=40 px running text, on screen early enough (audit FAILs text that has too little reading time). Earlier is fine, late is not.
out/ holds finals only: <Slug>_reel_9x16.mp4, cover_reel_9x16.png, publish.txt (v0.9: no 4:5 cut, no 4:5 cover, no SRT).
Every number comes from facts.json (url + quote). Single-source numbers are said in the pinned comment.

Plan runs in its own chat. Build and Finish of an episode run in ONE chat: after 'go ahead' on the preview, continue straight into the FINISH card in the same chat (no new chat, keep the claim). Claim the episode before touching it; close with studio.py close.
Publish title: <= 45 characters, a question with "আপনি/আপনার" or a known object + number, never the answer (shown over the Short in the feed).

ONE cover per episode in the series layout (cover_series.py): full-bleed real photo, chip, one white line, one bright colour block with the question (one line, >=140 px), no answer on the cover; COVER PASS. Baked right away as frame 1, embedded thumbnail and the 1.6 s cover opening; re-bake only if the creator asks for another.

Efficiency (v0.10): Build + Finish run in the Mac shell with bash _series/es.sh <tool>; no cloud copy, no pack/guard pushes. Scenes come from build.json via build_scenes (never hand-write index.html). Read only the card, the cheat sheet and `studio words`; never open engine/tool source, the tracker, the build plan or old notes. One image look per check (img sheet, keys_one, cover sheet).

reports.script: SCRIPT PASS - <n> scenes - est. <s> s (budget 60). Then the script table. Flags: max 3 one-line items. Ask only: OK?
reports.vo_and_images: One message: (1) the VO paste text in a code block, (2) the image table: # - filename - what it shows - REAL or AI (+ Gemini prompt for AI rows). No other text.
reports.ready: videoNN ready. Drop images in images/ and the single VO take in vo/raw/vo_full.mp3, then open a new chat: Build episode NN.
reports.missing: Cannot build yet: missing <what>. (one line, then stop)
reports.preview: Preview ready: <file> - <s> s - look <palette> - music <music>. Reply 'go ahead' (cover + finish follow here) or timestamped notes. (+1 line only if VO cuts were BEST-ESTIMATE or another judgement call; +1 line 'time cut: ...' only if there is one)
reports.delivered: Delivered ep NN - <s> s - videoNN/out/. Cover (baked): <chip> / <line> / <block> - say if you want another. Caveat: <single-source items, 1 line>. Next: <one step>.

plan: PLAN videoNN  (input = the title; no brief gate)
1. Research in standard search mode (several queries in one turn). Reuse the shared figures; facts.json rows need url + quote.

2. Write script.json + docs/script.md. One question, 85-100 Bangla words (~40-45 s; hard max ~130), scene 1 = the viewer's stake or one short question (lands in ~1.5 s), ends with the 'কমেন্টে লিখুন' question.
3. python3 engine/tools/script_check.py videoNN  ->  must print SCRIPT PASS (fix every FAIL first).
4. Send the script (report 'script'). GATE: creator OK -> state.py videoNN approve script  (brief is auto-approved: state.py videoNN approve brief --note 'title given').
5. After OK, send ONE message (report 'vo_and_images'): vo_text.py videoNN -> vo/vo_paste.txt + the image table (video-script 3b).

6. Prepare folders: python3 engine/tools/studio.py new videoNN --title '<title>' --ep NN  (project + palette + music), then push to the Mac skeleton (new-video 4, pack.py) ; state.py videoNN stage folders-ready.
7. Reply with report 'ready'. Then python3 engine/tools/studio.py close videoNN folders-ready.
build: BUILD videoNN  (v0.10: Mac shell ONLY — every command runs with device_bash from the VIDEO GEN folder ($HOME/mnt/VIDEO GEN). Never pack/pull the episode to the cloud, never open engine or tool source code.)

0. bash _series/es.sh version must equal the plugin version (else in the cloud: bash <plugin>/engine/tools/mac/make_kit.sh, commit the 2 files it names, move the old kit to _to_delete/). bash _series/es.sh guard claim videoNN --who 'Build epNN <time>' (REFUSED = stop). images/ and vo/raw/vo_full.mp3 present? If not: report 'missing' and stop.

1. VO: if videoNN/docs/words.json exists: bash _series/es.sh words_import videoNN --apply; else bash _series/es.sh vo_split videoNN (BEST-ESTIMATE = fine, one line in the report). Then bash _series/es.sh vo_prep videoNN && bash _series/es.sh state videoNN stage vo-received.
2. bash _series/es.sh studio look videoNN && bash _series/es.sh prep_photos videoNN; stage + look at img/_sheet_0.jpg ONCE (garbled text / odd hands).
3. bash _series/es.sh studio words videoNN → write videoNN/build.json from the CHEAT SHEET below with ONE device_bash heredoc (one scene per VO clip; scene 1 loud from t = 0; numbers get a src line).

4. bash _series/es.sh build_scenes videoNN → fix its WARN lines in build.json → bash _series/es.sh audit videoNN (--fast while iterating) until QA PASS. Edit build.json with a small python/sed patch, never rewrite it.
5. bash _series/es.sh audio videoNN && bash _series/es.sh studio check videoNN --stage build → STUDIO PASS.
6. bash _series/es.sh render videoNN --preview --name <Slug> (~35-60 s) && bash _series/es.sh review videoNN --one → stage + look at out/keys_one.jpg ONCE; fix only real problems.
7. mv out/<Slug>_preview.mp4 drafts/; bash _series/es.sh state videoNN stage built; stage the preview and send it (SendUserFile); report 'preview'.

8. On 'go ahead': bash _series/es.sh state videoNN approve preview && bash _series/es.sh studio close videoNN preview-approved; KEEP the claim and continue at once with the FINISH card in THIS chat. Never ask for a new chat.
finish: FINISH videoNN  (same chat as Build, straight after 'go ahead'; Mac shell only. The cover is baked right away — no cover OK wait.)

1. ONE cover in the series layout: bash _series/es.sh cover_series videoNN --photo images/<x> --chip '...' --line '...' --block '...' --render → COVER PASS (a too-wide block moves its first words into the line by itself). Stage + look at out/_cover_A_sheet.jpg ONCE.
2. Write videoNN/out/publish.txt in the layout of the previous episode's out/publish.txt (rules: series-rules.md 'publish.txt'). No placeholders.

3. bash _series/es.sh finish videoNN --local --slug <Slug> --who '<the claim label>' — run the SAME command again while it prints RESUME; it must end with DONE (render, check, bake, lint, state, tidy, tracker, titles_descriptions.md, lock release).
4. bash _series/es.sh studio check videoNN --stage final → STUDIO PASS, then bash _series/es.sh studio close videoNN delivered --note '<single-source caveat>'.
5. Stage the reel + cover, send them (SendUserFile), report 'delivered'. If the creator wants another cover: cover_series again, then the same finish command (it re-bakes).

stage_waiting_on.script-approved: Claude: VO text + image list + folders
stage_waiting_on.folders-ready: YOU: images + VO take, then 'Build episode NN'
stage_waiting_on.built: YOU: watch preview, 'go ahead' or notes
stage_waiting_on.preview-approved: Claude: cover (baked right away) + finish, same chat as Build

_history_note: Colour family of episodes 1-24 (from the cover log; orange counts as coral). Used only to skip a family used by one of the three previous episodes when no docs/look.json exists for them.
